Record the finding in src/vendor/pdf-server/PATCH.md (or a successor NOTICE file once §7.2 is finalized — the vendor is unmodified so no PATCH.md exists yet) and reflect the result in spec §7.2 and §17. Blocks foundation because cycle 6.2 vendors the dist; blocks packaging because cycle 6.13 archives it into the .plugin redistributable.

CI for the scholar plugin: bun install, bun typecheck (tsc --noEmit), bun test, scripts/build-plugin.ts smoke run. Spec §6.1 cites "basic CI" without enumerating jobs; this chore turns that into a concrete workflow file. Does not block any single plan (each plan's local tests pass under bun test) but should land before merging the foundation branch so downstream plans benefit from CI signal.

Document the re-vendor procedure for upstream @modelcontextprotocol/server-pdf bumps. Cycle 6.2 verification of the vendored copy (the roots/list responder fixture suite, list_changed round-trip, viewUUID survival across root mutation per spec §16) should produce the anchor quotes that mechanically detect drift on a new upstream release. Output is a short doc (likely docs/vendor/pdf-server-revendor.md) referenced from §7.2 and §16.

The XSDs in .claude/context/schema/ (untracked at filing time) reject both the existing registry data and the attributes the spec-pipeline workflow itself writes. Concrete drift: (1) plans.xsd requires <reference> with name/path/created-at/modified-at/context attributes — the wrap commit added the element but none of those attrs; (2) plan-group requires synopsis as an attribute (currently a child element) and disallows modified-at, which workflow step 8 writes; (3) chore.id must match `\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-...` — the three existing chore ids do not; (4) chore requires type/origin/baseline/index/expendable/synopsis and forbids blast-radius/blocks-plans (both used by every existing entry); (5) splits.xsd expects root <plan-splits> with spec/generated-at attrs and per-plan synopsis attribute — splits.xml has none of that. Decide between: (a) relax/replace the schemas to match the active pipeline + existing data, (b) retrofit data + workflow code to schemas, (c) drop the schemas entirely and document the implicit contract elsewhere. Until decided, xmllint validation in spec-pipeline workflow step 2 (spec-to-multi-plan) and any future ingest-spec re-runs cannot be honored as written.

Analytical-tier chore (Claude subagent, opus); requires judgment on which sub-clauses to preserve vs. delete vs. rewrite. Foundation-009 + extraction-003 + corpus-005 plan-mds all reference this amendment; the chore execution must produce a spec consistent with what those plan-mds describe.

Cycle 6.14 owns the bodies of src/server/tools/{query,backup,inspect}.ts (foundation-009 scaffolds the stubs; extraction-003 fills the bodies). Amend spec §11.5 to reflect chunk-ID determinism pivot from SHA-256-based content-addressed IDs to ULID + UPSERT on (paper_id, ordinal) per user Ruling B on 2026-05-24. Driver: advisor flagged that SHA-256 chunk-IDs require an embedding-status state machine to handle re-extraction idempotency, which adds complexity vs. UPSERT-on-natural-key (paper_id, ordinal). Mechanical-tier chore (copilot-cli, gpt-5-mini); §11.5 paragraph is replaced with the ULID+UPSERT narrative + the embedded_at column semantics + the unique-index on (paper_id, ordinal). Extraction-003 plan-md's cycle 6.5 task 5 has the canonical wording.

Amend spec §13 to specify the tombstone-resurrection edge case in annotation reconciliation: when an annotation is deleted in scholar but resurfaces from a subsequent pdf-child round-trip (the pdf-child has no knowledge of scholar's deletion), the reconciliation logic must distinguish "new annotation never seen" from "tombstoned annotation, do not resurrect". Mechanism: scholar persists deletion-tombstones (annotation_id + deleted_at) in the corpus DB; the §13 phase-1 reads include the tombstone table; phase-3 reconciliation skips re-insertion of tombstoned IDs. Analytical-tier chore (Claude subagent, opus); requires judgment on tombstone-table schema + TTL semantics + reconciliation pseudocode. Annotations-002 plan-md should reference this chore in its execution-order prerequisites; if annotations-002's plan-review surfaces this gap not addressed, the chore must complete BEFORE cycle 6.7 execution begins.

Amend frontends-005's cycle 6.9 Task list to pin the `ui://scholar/pdf/<paper_id>` MCP custom-URI scheme on the `resources/read` channel implemented in `src/server/ui/resource.ts`. Foundation-009 scaffolds resource.ts as a Task 1.10b stub (foundation-009 lines 2081-2129) but does NOT pin the pdf URI scheme — verified by grep on foundation-009 plan-md returning no matches for `ui://scholar/pdf` or `resources/read`. Frontends-005 fills the body at cycle 6.9 but currently lacks the pdf-resource-handler task. CLAUDE.md "Architecture" section verbatim anchor: "single-file UI bundle — React, built by Bun's HTML bundler …" and the "Conventions" section anchor: scholar MCP tools start with `scholar.`; the corresponding MCP custom-URI scheme is `ui://scholar/<resource>` (per CLAUDE.md item "`ui://scholar/<resource>` MCP custom URI scheme via foundation's `src/server/ui/resource.ts`"). Acceptance criteria: (1) frontends-005 cycle 6.9 Task list enumerates a "Pin `ui://scholar/pdf/<paper_id>` URI scheme + `resources/read` handler" sub-task with explicit reference to foundation-009 Task 1.10b as the scaffold being filled; (2) the handler signature is documented as `async (request: ReadResourceRequest) => ReadResourceResponse` resolving the paper, opening the PDF via `ctx.pdf` child, returning `{contents: [{uri, mimeType: "application/pdf", blob: base64Pdf}]}` per MCP spec; (3) Red test in `src/server/ui/resource.test.ts` asserting the `ui://scholar/pdf/p1` URI resolves to a base64-encoded PDF blob; (4) blast-radius confined to docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-22-scholar-plugin-frontends.md (chore is a plan-md amendment, NOT a src/ edit). Interpretive-tier chore (Claude subagent, sonnet) — requires judgment on the precise insertion point in frontends-005's existing cycle 6.9 task list and on the exact handler contract surface. Driver: extraction-003 DM 2026-05-24 surfaced that `scholar.pdf.open` is a thin proxy to pdf-MCP child returning `{success, viewUUID}` (extraction-003 lines 39, 727, 889-891, 1289, 1297) — NOT a URL — so the iframe-PDF URL must ride the MCP resources/read channel, which requires a pinned URI scheme. Companion to chore `frontends-adapt-extraction-contract` (which rewrites the F2 conformance test to assert against resources/read with this URI).

Amend frontends-005 plan-md to absorb extraction-003's post-commit cross-plan pin response (DM'd 2026-05-24, ~3 minutes after atomic commit f92ae94). Multi-part amendment across three contract domains plus four load-bearing semantic anchors quoted verbatim from spec §11, §9.3, and CLAUDE.md.
PART A — Contract 1 (F2 PDF URL conformance test rewrite). Current frontends-005 lines 794-828 contain an F2 PDF URL conformance test asserting `scholar.pdf.open` returns an HTTP/HTTPS URL fetchable by the iframe; this is wrong because extraction-003 cycle 6.5 (lines 39-44) defines `scholar.pdf.open` as a thin proxy to the pdf-MCP child returning `{success: boolean, viewUUID: string}`. Rewrite the test to assert the iframe-PDF URL is sourced from MCP `resources/read({uri: "ui://scholar/pdf/<paper_id>"})` (the URI scheme pinned by companion chore `pin-ui-scholar-pdf-resource-scheme-in-frontends`). The current PENDING comment ("extraction plan must confirm URL scheme before this test is authoritative" — frontends-005 line 802) is now resolvable and must be removed.
PART B — Contract 3 (field-rename mechanics). Update every frontends call-site reference, type definition, mock fixture, and Red test to match extraction-003's verbatim shapes:
(1) `scholar.papers.search` — args: rename `query`→`q`, DROP `corpus_id` (per-corpus DB context comes from `ctx.db` snapshot), DROP `mode` (always-on hybrid via RRF per extraction-003 line 1049). Result: rename `papers[]`→`hits[]`, ADD `still_indexing: boolean` field. Source-of-truth: extraction-003 lines 1167-1169 + 1237 (`type SearchArgs = { q: string; limit?: number }; type SearchResult = { hits: SearchHit[]; still_indexing: boolean }`).
(2) `scholar.digest.generate` — args: DROP `corpus_id`, REPLACE `since: string` with `scope_key: "all" | "section:<label>" | "stale" | "selection:<hash>"` enum, ADD `use_claude?: boolean` (defaults false). Result: rename `digest_md`→`body_md`, ADD optional `askClaude?: AskClaudeSentinel` (per SA2 below). Source-of-truth: extraction-003 lines 1485-1486 (`scope_key: string; // "all" | "section:foo" | "stale" | "selection:<hash>"` and `use_claude?: boolean; // opt-in per request; DEFAULT FALSE per CLAUDE.md`), line 1496 (`body_md: string;`), lines 1563-1566 (insert into `digests(id, scope_key, scope_signature, body_md, ...)`), line 1572 (`{ description: "Generate a Markdown digest. Default: Ollama. Pass use_claude=true to route to cowork.askClaude instead." }`).
(3) `scholar.prompts.generate` — args: DEFER `intent` (v1.1; not in v1 shape), DEFER `target_section` (v1.1), ADD `use_claude?: boolean` (defaults false). Result: flat `prompts: string[]` (no nested structure), ADD optional `askClaude?: AskClaudeSentinel`. Source-of-truth: extraction-003 line 1750 (`type Args = { paper_id: string; use_claude?: boolean }`), line 1817 (tool description: `"Generate reading-comprehension prompts for a paper. Default: Ollama. Pass use_claude=true to route to cowork.askClaude."`).
PART C — SA1–SA4 verbatim semantic anchors (load-bearing acceptance criteria, NOT mere field-renames). These four anchors must each land as a named Red test that fails BEFORE the corresponding UI feature lands, and as an explicit acceptance bullet in frontends-005's cycle 6.9 task list.
SA1 (still_indexing pill). Spec §11 verbatim: "Semantic-search code paths (`scholar.papers.search` with semantic mode) check `settings.chunk_vec.created` and degrade to lexical with a 'still indexing' pill when false — the same affordance used for partially-embedded chunks." (spec line 1007; identical phrasing reused at spec line 1346). Frontends MUST render a "still indexing" pill in `CorpusDashboard` and `PaperDetail` views when `searchResult.still_indexing === true`. Red test in `src/ui/views/CorpusDashboard.test.tsx`: pill present when mock has `still_indexing: true`; pill absent when `false`.
SA2 (askClaude sentinel + host-capability detection). Spec §11 verbatim: "On seeing `structuredContent.askClaude`, the UI calls `window.cowork.askClaude(askClaude.prompt, askClaude.data)` (a host-provided global in the MCP App iframe) and renders the result. This sentinel shape is the contract shared between the producers (`src/server/tools/digest.ts`, `prompts.ts`) and the consumer (`src/ui/views/DigestPanel.tsx`)." (spec lines 1015-1028, see also F8 host-capability prose at spec lines 1030-1035: "`window.cowork.askClaude` is a Cowork-host-provided global … The UI feature-detects with `typeof window.cowork?.askClaude === 'function'` on mount … Absent. The toggle is hidden entirely; in its place the UI renders a single static note: *'Claude fallback unavailable in this host.'* Servers still receive `askClaude: undefined` in tool calls (the toggle was never offered)"). Frontends `DigestPanel` + `ReadingPromptsPane` MUST (a) feature-detect `window.cowork?.askClaude` on mount, (b) hide the toggle entirely + render the static "Claude fallback unavailable in this host." note when absent, (c) forward `askClaude.prompt`/`askClaude.data` to `window.cowork.askClaude(...)` when the server returns `structuredContent.askClaude` and the host supports it. Two Red tests: capability-detect (host-absent path renders static note + omits toggle); sentinel-forwarding (host-present + structuredContent.askClaude present → window.cowork.askClaude called with prompt+data args).
SA3 (scope_key enum — digest scope contract). Spec §9.3 verbatim: "Defaults to the current scope. Shows the cached digest if recent; otherwise calls `app.callServerTool('digest.generate', {scope_key})` which runs the Ollama chat model against a `paperLine`-style corpus slice (preserving the Daisy prompt skeleton but rewriting it for Qwen)." (spec line 935). Spec §8.2 verbatim: `scope_key: text("scope_key").notNull()` (spec line 841). Frontends `DigestPanel` MUST construct tool args with `scope_key` (NOT `since`) and accept the four enum patterns: `"all" | "section:<label>" | "stale" | "selection:<hash>"`. Type-check Red test asserting tool-call args carry `scope_key` field matching one of the four enum patterns.
SA4 (use_claude opt-in — mechanical-LLM-default discipline). CLAUDE.md "Load-bearing invariants" verbatim: "Mechanical LLM → local Ollama. Embeddings, digest, and reading-prompts default to local Ollama. `cowork.askClaude` is an explicit per-request opt-in only — never the default path." Spec §11 verbatim: "Mechanical LLM work → **Ollama by default**; `cowork.askClaude` is opt-in only." (spec line 1361). Spec §1 risks-table verbatim: "Mechanical LLM work routes through local Ollama, not the Claude API." | "User directive." | "All routine syntheses, reading-prompt generation, and embedding production default to Ollama. `cowork.askClaude` is opt-in only for high-stakes synthesis." (spec line 66). Frontends MUST default `use_claude` to FALSE (or omit the field, which equals false at the server) on every `digest.generate` and `prompts.generate` tool call; the "use Claude instead" toggle (offered only when SA2's host-capability detect returns present) MUST set `use_claude: true` ONLY when explicitly toggled by the user. Two Red tests: default-tool-call shape has `use_claude: false` (or field omitted); toggle-on-then-fire test asserts `use_claude: true` rides the request.
PART D — Optional additives DEFERRED (lead disposition 2026-05-24): `snippet?: string` on `SearchHit` and `papers_referenced: string[]` on `GenerateResult` are NOT included in v1; defer to v1.1. Do NOT add these to frontends-005.
Acceptance criteria summary: (1) F2 test rewritten against MCP resources/read URI; PENDING comment removed; (2) all three Contract 3 tool surfaces match extraction-003 shapes verbatim; (3) four named Red tests (SA1 pill, SA2 capability+forward, SA3 scope_key enum, SA4 use_claude default-false) landed with the spec-§/CLAUDE.md anchor quotes preserved as the test docstrings or adjacent comments so future maintainers can trace the invariant to the spec; (4) optional additives explicitly NOT added with a one-line deferral note. Blast radius confined to docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-22-scholar-plugin-frontends.md (chore is a plan-md amendment, NOT a src/ edit; src/ edits ride the eventual frontends-cycle-6.9 execution). Interpretive-tier chore (Claude subagent, sonnet) — requires judgment on insertion points within frontends-005's existing task list, on phrasing of Red test docstrings, and on preserving the four anchor quotes verbatim without paraphrase drift. Companion to chore `pin-ui-scholar-pdf-resource-scheme-in-frontends` which provides the URI scheme that Part A's rewritten F2 test asserts against — execute that chore first or together.
